Introducing Zeta 3

Oct 27, 2026

Today we are releasing Zeta 3. Zeta 3 is our most capable model for coding, reasoning and long tasks, and it is available today in the app and the API.

Pricing and availability

In the API, Zeta 3 costs $2 per million input tokens and $8 per million output tokens. It is rolling out to all paid plans starting today, and to free users over the coming weeks.

  • Up to 1M tokens of context
  • Native tool use and computer use
  • Available in 40 languages including Japanese

We evaluated Zeta 3 on a wide range of benchmarks and it outperforms our previous models on most of them, while using fewer tokens on average for the same quality.
